subject: Error with qplot on MAC OS X

messages.author: d316db42e3d272b5
messages.subject: Error with qplot on MAC OS X
parts:
Hi All,

I am using RStudio 0.95.265 on MAC OS X 10.7.3 and I am trying the
following:

>library(ggplot2)
>qplot(displ, hwy, data = mpg)

And I have the following error

Error in grid.Call(L_textBounds, as.graphicsAnnot(x$label), x$x, x
$y, :
Polygon edge not found
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In grid.Call(L_textBounds, as.graphicsAnnot(x$label), x$x, x$y, :
no font could be found for family "Arial"
2: In grid.Call(L_textBounds, as.graphicsAnnot(x$label), x$x, x$y, :
no font could be found for family "Arial"

Cheers,

Joao

messages.author: f8e55a9831f407bc
messages.subject: Re: Error with qplot on MAC OS X
parts: after some more digging, i discovered that the arial fonts on my system had been disabled (<font face="arial, sans-serif">the files</font> had been placed in <font face="'courier new', monospace">/Library/Fonts Disabled/</font><font face="arial, sans-serif">), even though Font Book still reported Arial present, however this was the version stored in the Microsoft fonts directory (</font><font face="'courier new', monospace">/Library/Fonts/Microsoft/</font><font face="arial, sans-serif">).  i moved the fonts back from the disabled folder, the resolved the duplicate fonts from within Font Book.</font>
